An '''audio scanner''' was a type of [[Security scanner/Legends|security scanner]]. When used in conjunction with [[Visual scanner]]s and [[infrared receptor]]s, audio scanners could watch over a large area and detect and record the actions of any intruders.<ref name="EGWT" />
